Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Child & Youth Development Education Secondary Sectors Youth Informal Education Geographies Served Programs Project Ullaasa District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Project Ullaasa, an Inter-personal & Artistic Skill Development Initiative, focuses on empowering grassroots students to shape the future of their communities and society at large. By imparting essential skills such as public speaking, debating, and articulation, the project aims to enhance their interpersonal abilities. During the lockdown, YuvaSpark adapted the course to teach students the art of argumentative and critical thinking, which evolved into interactive workshops across Bengaluru. In addition to speaking skills, the initiative also encourages children to explore and engage in art, crafts, and music, providing a holistic approach to their development. Project Vineeta Project Vineeta, an Academic Mentoring Initiative, aims to offer academic mentorship to underprivileged students. Through weekly classes at orphanages, volunteers provide both curricular and extracurricular lessons, along with mentoring support. The initiative has yielded positive outcomes, with students excelling in their school classes. During the pandemic, the project adapted to online platforms, ensuring continuity in learning and enabling students from distant locations to participate in classes without hindrance. The classes have been well-received by both students and volunteers, and the programme continues to thrive with enthusiasm and dedication. Project Q District Mysore Cachar Dharwad Bangalore Bangalore Rural Bellary Hassan Satara State Karnataka Assam Maharashtra District Mysore Cachar Dharwad Bangalore Bangalore Rural Bellary Hassan Satara States Karnataka Assam Maharashtra Project Q, one of YuvaSpark's initiatives, aimed to provide relief and support to stranded migrant labourers during the COVID-19 lockdown and re-establish connections between school teachers and students in partnered orphanages. The project involved several impactful programmes, including food distribution, distributing masks and sanitisers, and providing digital education tools like tablets and laptops to ensure uninterrupted learning for underprivileged students. Additionally, Project Q 2.0, initiated during the second wave of the pandemic, focused on supporting healthcare in rural areas. It procured and deployed various medical equipment, including oxygen concentrators, masks, PPE kits, and more, across multiple districts and states, benefiting government hospitals, Primary Health Centres, Isolation Centres, and a COVID Care Centre. Smart Anganwadi Programme District Ramanagara State Karnataka District Ramanagara States Karnataka YuvaSpark's Smart Anganwadi Project implements a 48-module, Kannada-language curriculum with teacher training sessions and assessments for children. The initiative aims to leverage the crucial period of early childhood development to lay a strong foundation for future education and learning. Recognizing the significance of quality pre-primary education in a child's educational journey, the programme focuses on improving learning outcomes in rural areas by utilizing interactive, custom-designed digital modules aligned with the Chili Pili curriculum. The introduction of interactive smart classrooms enhances the learning experience for children, while comprehensive teacher training ensures effective utilization of these digital tools. The ultimate goal is to catalyze pedagogical innovation at Anganwadi Centres in rural Karnataka, promoting value-based education, and increasing enrollment rates, foundational literacy, and numeracy skills. Digital Anganwadi Programme Utilizing a cloud-based technology platform and cutting-edge data engineering, the Digital Anganwadi project by YuvaSpark aims to catalyze pedagogical innovation at Early Childhood Education Centres in rural India. Empowering Anganwadi teachers, the initiative provides access to custom-curated interactive vernacular language academic content, focusing on foundational numeracy, foundational literacy, and value-based education. Through extensive curriculum research and partnerships with the Women and Child Development department, the project iteratively develops its programme, analyzing data points to improve learning outcomes. Engaging multiple volunteers across India, the initiative compiles digital learning tools in various languages, contributing to enhanced education for children aged 3 to 6 in Anganwadi centres. Milestones & Track Record YuvaSpark has expanded from Bangalore to operate across 10 states in India, implemented 9 major projects, and rebranded from SPARK to YuvaSpark to reflect their growth. --> --> Leadership Team Akarsh Shroff Founder & Chief Executive Officer Aakarshan Majumdar Vice - President Darsh Mishra Head - Operations Arya Thipse Head - HR Indraneel Acharya Associate Vice - President, Finance M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAYTS1414L Registration Number 004/36/2019-20 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2022/0331988 --> 80G AAYTS1414LF20217 12A AAYTS1414LE20219 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2018 Demographies Served Youth Children --> Impact Yuvaspark has made an impact, engaging over 700 volunteers who contributed more than 30,000 hours of volunteering, garnering support from 1,500+ donors, and positively impacting the lives of over 3,46,000 beneficiaries across 10 states through 9 projects in collaboration with 8 partners. Vision and Mission YuvaSpark envisions a world where young people play an active role in the socio-economic development of their countries. Their mission is to empower children with the tools they need to thrive and contribute positively to society. fields.description: YuvaSpark is a social welfare platform, functioning in 11 locations, with 5,000+ beneficiaries and 500+ Volunteers collectively contributing, over 16,000 hours of work. At YuvaSpark, we work with orphans and the underprivileged with a vision of bringing together young social leaders to create a - “BIGGER, BETTER AND A BRIGHTER FUTURE”.
